title: Eddie Griffin: Undeniable
description: The comic celebrates a 30-year anniversary in comedy by discussing the world, relationships and humanity.

title: Kevin Bozeman: Clean and Unfiltered
description: In 1999, Kevin found himself in the real world with no real job skills and a strong desire to work an hour a day.

title: Lavell Crawford: I Could Eat - Part 1
description: Lavell Crawford is back and here to contemplate how "My 600 Pound Life" could go for 15 seasons and he was still underweight, the kind of racist you have to be to not take a free holiday, and explosive consequences in a Taco Bell bathroom.

title: Shayne Smith: Alligator Boys
description: Comedian Shayne Smith shares stories about everything from a failed robbery to a wrestling match in the New York Subway and even saving the life of a dog in this stand-up special.

title: Bill Engvall: Here's Your Sign: It's Finally Time: My Last Show
description: Bill Engvall, renowned comedian, entertains audiences for the last time.

title: Gabriel Iglesias: I'm Not Fat... I'm Fluffy
description: The comic known for wearing his signature Hawaiian shirts covers everything from his fondness for Paul Rodriguez to his own "fluffiness."

title: Arnez J: Racially Motivated
description: A comedy performance by Arnez J at Boston's Wilbur Theater.

title: Chris Porter: Ugly and Angry
description: Chris Porter of Last Comic Standing performs his comedy routine in Kansas City.

title: Dennis Gaxiola: Before the Wall Goes Up
description: Dennis Gaxiola gained notoriety from his appearances with Jamie Foxx on Comedy Central, the Latin Kings of Comedy Tour with Paul Rodriguez, BET's Comic View, Que Locos and the 2010 season of Martin Lawrence's First Amendment Stand Up.

title: Even More Funny Women of a Certain Age
description: Golden Globe winner Teri Hatcher joins the stage with some of the funniest women in comedy for one night of over-the-top, uninhibited standup.

title: Kiran Deol: Joysuck
description: Kiran remembers waking up at five years old, excited to start the day, but then, growing up and things that chip away wonderful feelings.

title: Maija DiGiorgio: Maija! Maija! Maija!
description: Maija DiGiorgio examines the complexities of what it means to be a mixed race, multicultural woman.

title: Matt Braunger: Finally Live In Portland
description: Matt Braunger offers insights on the world, the bad decisions that have shaped him and how they brought him to find his better half.

title: Matt Braunger: Big, Dumb Animal
description: Comic Matt Braunger explains why single men are so creepy, describes the drunken antics he observed as a bartender and details a surprisingly stressful bingo victory.

title: Tammy Pescatelli: Finding the Funny
description: A stand-up performance from Tammy Pescatelli about life.

title: Tammy Pescatelli's Way After School Special
description: Tammy Pescatelli performs at her hometown high school.

title: Jim Gaffigan: The Pale Tourist - Canadian American
description: Jim Gaffigan performs in Canada and has some very strong opinions on poutine, Saskatchewan, health care and the pronunciation of the city of Regina.

title: Gabriel Iglesias: Aloha Fluffy
description: The comic discusses his crazy world of family, friends, and world travels.

title: Gabriel Iglesias: Hot and Fluffy
description: Filmed at the Fox Theater in Bakersfield, California the comedian and well-known favorite to television viewers as being on "Last Comic Standing," performs impressions and silly voices.

title: Anjelah Johnson: Mahalo & Goodnight
description: Filmed at the Hawaii Theater in Honolulu, Hawaii, Anjelah Johnson's fourth stand-up comedy special dishes on awkward massages, home invasions, spiders and being a full-grown child.

title: Anjelah Johnson: The Homecoming Show
description: Stand-up comedian Anjelah Johnson returns to San Jose, Calif., for a special performance.

title: Gina Yashere: Laughing To America
description: Gina Yashere takes the stage to perform her unapologetically hilarious stand-up routine.

title: Lavell Crawford I Could Eat Part 2
description: Meat's on the menu with Lavell Crawford keeping Burger King humble to their have it your way slogan, godless vegetarians, and why the best chicken is from a house of God.

title: Dennis Miller: America 180
description: Dennis Miller shares his opinion on today's America, including the current state of the nation, the failures of Obama's healthcare initiative and the antics of our top leaders.

title: Kevin Smith: Silent But Deadly Extended Edition
description: Kevin Smith is anything but quiet in this new comedy special that was recorded an hour before his heart attack in February; before he nearly died backstage, onstage he discusses his marriage, his kid and his work (or lack thereof).

title: Michael Ian Black: Very Famous
description: The comic in his first stand-up special shares his insight on everything from skydiving to uncreative Halloween costumes.

title: Michael Ian Black: Noted Expert
description: Michael Ian Black offers his take on the human experience.

title: Andrew Schiavone: Central Nervousness

title: Jim Breuer: Let's Clear the Air
description: The comic performs.

description: Comic Jim Breuer deals with being a middle-aged dad in suburbia.

description: Logan Guntzelman shares with an Atlanta crowd tales of her dating app standards, moving in with a boyfriend, and upgrades in male health technology.

title: Jeff Dunham: Arguing With Myself

title: Jeff Dunham: Minding the Monsters

title: Jeff Dunham: Spark of Insanity
description: Jeff Dunham returns with new ventriloquist characters by starting off with the infamously known Walter, scrutinizing every bit of today's American society.

title: Jeff Dunham: Unhinged in Hollywood

title: Travis Nelson: To Touch A Cloud

title: Bob Zany: I Think I Handled That Well
description: Bob Zany performs standup.

title: Steve Hofstetter: A Trip to Japan

title: David Huntsberger: One Headed Beast

title: Matt Besser: Besser Breaks the Record

title: Jimmy O. Yang: Guess How Much?
